head: Warhammer Survivors is out on iPhone, from the makers of Boltgun and Vampire Survivors
dek: Warhammer Survivors, a survivors-style action game set in the Warhammer universes, launched on iPhone and was #3 among all paid apps on the US App Store on 10 November.
details: It's made by Auroch Digital with Warhammer and poncle, the studio behind Vampire Survivors. It has more than 40 playable characters and 75-plus weapons. It costs $7.19 with in-app purchases and needs iOS 15.
means: If you like Vampire Survivors, this is the same kind of game with Warhammer characters.
todo: Find Warhammer Survivors in the App Store.
